campaign.name: Connecticut Pension Fund — Letter Campaign
campaign.description: Tell Connecticut state officials to protect public pensions and refuse risky private-equity exposure.
campaign.body_md: Public pensions in Connecticut affect tens of thousands of retirees, teachers, and state workers. Send a personalized letter — by email or post — to the officials who set state investment policy.

targets.description: Connecticut's Treasurer is the sole fiduciary of the state pension fund.
